summary: Hot inflation data spooked markets Wednesday, with the Nasdaq leading declines as chipmakers and megacap tech sold off. S&P futures were down about 1.3% while the VIX spiked roughly 11%.
market_note: The CPI surprise has traders pricing out another Fed cut, with some talk of a hike back on the table.

items.why: Chipmakers led the Nasdaq lower after hot inflation data revived Fed rate-hike talk; Reuters notes chipmakers fell as bank earnings rolled in.
Megacap tech sold off on the hot inflation print, which cooled rate-cut hopes and dragged the Nasdaq down.
Chip weakness spread as inflation jitters lifted the threat of higher rates, hitting rate-sensitive tech hardest.
The fear gauge spiked about 11% as hot inflation data drove the S&P 500 and Nasdaq lower.
